MATHEMATICS — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #12
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. What is √16? (1 mark)
   A. 8
   B. 16
   C. 4
   D. 5

2. Find the GCD of 49 and 61. (1 mark)
   A. 49
   B. 1
   C. 2
   D. 1

3. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 15 cm by 6 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 30
   B. 21
   C. 90
   D. 42

4. Simplify 6x + 2 + 6x. (1 mark)
   A. 6x
   B. 12x + 2
   C. 12x
   D. 6x + 2

5. Which is greater: 1/4 or 2/2? (1 mark)
   A. Cannot tell
   B. They are equal
   C. 1/4
   D. 2/2

6. Calculate 23 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 23
   B. 23.7
   C. 23.6
   D. 29

7. What is 1/4 as a decimal? (1 mark)
   A. 0.025
   B. 0.205
   C. 2.5
   D. 0.25

8. Calculate 19 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 19
   B. 19.7
   C. 25
   D. 19.6

9. Which fraction is equivalent to 6/8? (1 mark)
   A. 3/4
   B. 1/2
   C. 1/4
   D. 2/3

10. Find the GCD of 25 and 37. (1 mark)
   A. 2
   B. 1
   C. 25
   D. 1

11. Find the GCD of 43 and 55. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 1
   C. 43
   D. 2

12. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 11 cm by 6 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 17
   B. 66
   C. 22
   D. 34

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. Show full working: A trader sells 15 items at Ksh 75 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

14. Show full working: A trader sells 16 items at Ksh 80 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

15. Show full working: A trader sells 17 items at Ksh 85 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

16. Show full working: A trader sells 18 items at Ksh 90 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)
